note: CLOSED list (KD4, session-settled 2026-08-17): these are the only categories that legitimize a `needs input:` exit with work still open. Agents cite a category; they never add one. New categories require explicit operator sign-off -- see CLAUDE.md and docs/plans/2026-08-17-2205-feat-positive-handoff-protocol-plan.md (R8, KD4). Consumed by scripts/needs-human.sh, which rejects any id not listed here.

categories.label: External message send
categories.applies_when: The remaining work requires sending an outbound message (Discord, Slack, email, webhook) that is not already gated by config.

categories.label: Production data mutation
categories.applies_when: The remaining work requires a write against production data (e.g. psql/redis-cli/supabase DELETE, DROP, or UPDATE).

categories.label: Persistence change
categories.applies_when: The remaining work requires changing a persistent system surface (e.g. crontab, systemctl unit) outside normal code review.

categories.label: Credential login or rotation
categories.applies_when: The remaining work requires a credential login or rotation (e.g. gh auth) that changes security posture.

categories.label: MCP server or plugin enablement
categories.applies_when: The remaining work requires enabling a new MCP server or plugin.

categories.label: Permission-surface edit
categories.applies_when: The remaining work requires editing the permission surface itself (settings.json allow/ask/deny, hook files, or CLAUDE.md).
